NoticeKit

NoticeKit is a browser-only toolkit for SaaS teams answering buyer AI security questionnaires.
It focuses on one-answer-now drafting, inventory-first cleanup, repeat-review answer banks, spreadsheet/workbook handoff, software-fit triage, proof/judgment gaps, and named-vendor or due-diligence routes when the buyer language widens.
Core free flows keep data in the browser and do not require an account.

Primary audience:
- B2B SaaS founders and operators
- Fractional security or privacy operators
- Startup attorneys and consultants supporting buyer review

Structured profile:
- JSON profile: https://noticekit.tech/noticekit-tool-profile.json

Key capabilities:
- Build one copy-ready AI questionnaire answer plus workbook-friendly handoff
- Reuse approved wording, proof links, and owner notes across repeated reviews
- Import questionnaire rows from CSV, TSV, or Excel
- Decide whether the team needs a local workflow, response software, management software, or an async audit
- Run vendor demos against the current queue, proof burden, and rollout risk instead of feature theater
- Use the proof-first route when the paragraph is fine but the owner, review date, or recheck trigger is missing
- Use named-vendor pages when the buyer names OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, Claude, or Microsoft Copilot
- Use response software, management software, automation, and SIG / CAIQ / VSAQ pages when the buyer is comparing workflow tools
- Move from route chooser to a smaller paid fit: Starter, Pro, or Audit
- Package proof, review dates, owner details, and recheck triggers when the thread widens
- Keep core free flows browser-only
